description: ANSI FIFO with #() parameters and synchronous reset; SVA with $rose/$fell/$past, repetition, ##N and a local capture variable.

notes.ap_fifo_data_after_empty_1_4: Genuine counterexample: the SVA declares 'reg[7:0] data_start' but captures the 16-bit din, so any write with upper bits set (e.g. 0x8000) mismatches dout. The SVA should use reg[15:0].
notes.ap_fifo_write_32_full: Vacuous: the FIFO is full after 7 writes and the assumption cp_fifo_full_no_write then forbids writing, so 32 consecutive writes can never happen.
